name: dropdown-menu
description: Native guidance for a Menu trigger with labeled actions, sections, and a picker inside the menu.
docs: Use a native `Menu` for dropdown actions; a `Picker` inside it becomes a checkmarked selection group and a `Divider` starts a section. The trigger takes any registry button style; the menu itself stays system-owned.
accessibility: The menu trigger keeps a visible text label; a symbol-only trigger needs an accessibility label.
Picker selection inside a menu announces the checked state.
Menu presentation, dismissal, and Liquid Glass are system behavior.
